messages:
Arjun (Support): heads up — escalated ticket from AcmeCorp, onboarding stalled. They hit repeated 403s on ingest and are worried about costs. ticket: #12345. raising to CS for priority handling. @Nora please take point.
Nora (CSM): on it. can you paste the last error snippet and whether this impacts embeddings or generation? need to assess customer-facing message.
Arjun (Support): errors look like token auth + burst queue. snippet: 
```
ERROR 403: tenant quota exceeded for tenant_id=acme-42
[ingest] rate_limiter: dropped 23 requests
```
This primarily affected the embedding pipeline during bulk import.
Megan (AE): renewal in 28 days, expansion opportunity with search feature. If onboarding drags we'll see churn risk. we should offer short-term credits + weekly checkpoint until resolved.
Kevin (Eng): quick triage steps I pushed to the ticket: check kv-cache TTL and reset ingest worker pool. commands: 
```bash
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/ingest -- curl -s localhost:9000/health
redis-cli -h redis.acme INCRBY ingest:backlog -1
```
I can roll a config change (lower concurrency) for 30m to stop error flood, then revert. need :30 for change window.
Nora (CSM): proposed comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement to customer within 1h, 2) apply engineering mitigation and update within 2h, 3) offer 10% onboarding credit + dedicated weekly sync until rollout. assigning owners below. please react if you disagree.
Arjun (Support): noted. I'll send initial ack. draft ack: 
```
Hi Team — thanks for flagging, we see the ingestion errors and our engineering team is working a mitigation now. We'll apply a temporary config to stop the failures and follow up within 2 hours with next steps. — Arjun, Support
```
Nora (CSM): I edited the customer message to include renewal context and next steps. final customer-facing message (send after engineering confirms mitigation): 
```
Hi <Name>,
We’ve identified the root cause of the ingest failures and applied a temporary mitigation to stabilize imports. We’ll continue monitoring and plan a follow-up by EOD with a permanent fix timeline. To make this right we’re applying a 10% onboarding credit and offering a weekly sync to finish roll out. Thanks for your patience — Nora, Customer Success
```
Megan (AE): agree. please cc me on follow-ups — I'll highlight strategic impact to their VP of Product.
Kevin (Eng): mitigation is ready, doing a canary deploy now. will post logs in ticket.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/ingest v2.1 started by Kevin (Eng) — 1777777798
Arjun (Support): got the green from Kevin, sending the ack now.
Nora (CSM): creating cs playbook steps and calendar invite for weekly checkpoint. ownership: Arjun = ticket updates, Kevin = fix + postmortem, Nora = customer comms/credits, Megan = renewal owner. meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT.
Megan (AE): thanks — I'll prepare the renewal risk note for sales ops.
Nora (CSM): closing loop here — will post final summary after postmortem. thanks team :thumbsup:
